card.line: The Valley of Ben-hinnom was a place near Jerusalem where Judah's people sacrificed their children in the fire, and God warned it would become the Valley of Slaughter.

moments.title: Ahaz burns his sons
moments.text: King Ahaz burned incense in the Valley of Ben-hinnom and sacrificed his sons in the fire, following the awful ways of the nations the LORD had driven out.

moments.title: Manasseh's evil
moments.text: King Manasseh sacrificed his sons in the fire in the valley. He also practiced sorcery and did great evil that made the LORD angry.

moments.title: Josiah defiles Topheth
moments.text: King Josiah desecrated Topheth in the valley so that no one could sacrifice a son or daughter in the fire to Molech.

moments.title: The broken jar
moments.text: The LORD told Jeremiah to go to the valley at the Potsherd Gate and speak to the leaders. He said the place would be called the Valley of Slaughter, and Jeremiah was to shatter a jar as a sign.

moments.title: A place God never commanded
moments.text: The LORD said the people built high places in the valley to burn their children in the fire, something He never commanded. He also promised to bring His people back and make an everlasting covenant with them.
